mark_prior_hour_comparison.limitation: Actual observation-to-observation UTC gap retained; approximately hourly means 45–75 minutes. No interpolation or rescaling to an exact one-hour return. Prior values are used only for this labelled comparison.

research_threshold_scope.quantity_oi: Absolute latest comparable current hourly base-asset quantity OI change >=5%.
research_threshold_scope.closed_1h_volume_and_body: Completed hourly volume >=2x arithmetic mean of at least six preceding verified completed hourly volumes AND same-bar absolute open-to-close change >=3%.
research_threshold_scope.mark: Absolute reliable approximately-one-hour same-contract primary mark change >=10%; actual gap 45–75 minutes.
research_threshold_scope.confirmation: A candidate requires a second fresh same-contract observation; no STRK standalone alert.
research_threshold_scope.missing_data: Unknown remains null; no old-value fill or chart-label UTC inference.

raw_capture_index_scope: Zero-based flattened current-run capture index. Each raw snippet also retains original input record index and optional within-batch index.
